lines: I run on with a parched heart
I'm sorry I couldn't do anything
To live untainted, without looking back,
you turn away and are gone
Even in the darkness of a world this cruel,
So my soul won't be broken by weakness
God bless... the two of us now
Deliver this longing as it burns hot
There's no reason to the ache of wanting to see you
At least let's take only beautiful dreams
and chase them as we draw them
Look me in the eye and tell me what happens from here
maybe if I grow strong I can change fate
My wish—I want it granted, and yet
You were there, and I was there,
Drawing the beauty of a faint dream,
Even in the darkness of a world this cruel,
So my soul won't be broken by weakness
God bless... the two of us now
